title: Keep billing authority in product rules, not the model
narrative: Fangore starts the CLI host with family `pass_through` and backend `mock`. A customer was charged twice. Only the billing team may own the ticket. The model may suggest a team, but product policy allows only when the route signal is billing — and a high quality score alone must not override missing completion evidence. He walks product steps (judge_route) and verifies completion from the structured observation expects on this scenario. Related: `fangore_decision_surface_reject`.
implementation:
Provider-neutral judge types (`Choice`/`Score`/`Noul` questions and signals) plus `JudgementPolicy` / `decide()` apply configured thresholds. `CliInstrumentor` verb `judge_route` runs judge+decide. System One maps vendor wire via `SystemOneJudgeProvider`.

Covers: POL-02, JDG-01, JDG-02, JDG-04, VER-02.
validation: Harness `user_story` scenario `billing_allow.yaml`: environment + graph + steps + complete expects.

footnotes.label: Jev decisions in a Pi harness
